# DSH AnnotateAnything

A small, unofficial **DeepSeek Harness** plugin for pointing at interface elements,
adding comments,

and sending their screenshots into the current conversation.
English and Russian UI are included. L

screenshots into the current conversation.
English and Russian UI are included. Licensed under MIT.
## What it does

- Adds an **Annotate** button beside the conversation input.
- Highlights elements under the pointer

. Click to annotate an element, or hold
the primary pointer button and drag to select a rectangle au

tomatically.
- Captures only the selected visible rectangle, with no annotation controls in the PNG.

- Lets you add several comments, then edit or delete them via numbered pins.
- Sends a numbered com

ment list and one cropped PNG per selection. Elements
include CSS selectors; arbitrary regions inclu

de viewport coordinates in CSS pixels.
- Supports selecting page elements inside the Desktop Browser

panel when its
Electron `webview` exposes `executeJavaScript` and `capturePage`.

This is a client-side plugin with an empty Host entry point, not a browser extension
or a standalone

screenshot utility. The pins are UI controls; the attached PNGs
are crops, not full-page images wit
h pins painted over them.

## Use

1. Open the conversation you want to send screenshots to.
2. Click **Annotate**. Click a highlighted

element, or hold the primary button
and drag a visible rectangle in any direction. There is no mode

switch.
In Desktop Browser, start the gesture inside the page.
3. Wait for the region screenshot, e

nter a comment and click **Add**. Repeat for
other elements or regions; both kinds can be mixed in t

he same submission.
4. Click a numbered pin to edit/delete its comment.
5. Click **Send** to submit
the annotations to the current conversation.

**Esc** cancels a drag first, then dismisses the current editor, or leaves
annotation mode if neithe

r is open. Movement below 4 CSS pixels counts as an

## Requirements and limitations

- Requires the Harness Web client, including `slots`, `locale`, `conversation`,
`sessions`, `convers

ation.input.left`, and `shell.overlay`.
- Requires image-draft APIs `conversation.createDrafts` and

`sendSession`.
Unsupported versions show an error instead of silently sending text only.
- React is

provided by Harness through its client module loader. `html-to-image`
is bundled; no separate captur

e service or API key is needed.
- Desktop guest-page capture relies on Electron APIs. An ordinary br

owser cannot
use those APIs; cross-origin iframe contents are not generally accessible.
- Host scree

nshots are DOM reconstructions, not OS screenshots. Video, protected
content, cross-origin resources

, canvas and unusual CSS may not reproduce.
Protected or cross-origin canvas/video inside a selectio

n cannot be read by
DOM capture and produces a specific error. Fonts are not embedded. Selected host

regions above 2.5 million CSS pixels are
rejected; choose a smaller visible selection. Region PNGs

are bounded to 1600
pixels on their longest edge. A region cannot span both Harness and a guest page

the comment is saved.
A failed or invalidated region capture must be selected again; Send never sile

ntly
recaptures different page content. Scroll, resize or navigation during capture
cancels it. Dyna

mic content can still change while a screenshot is being rendered.
- **Elements** retain capture on

Add and retry on Send. Keep their content visible
until capture finishes. Guest captures reject a ch

ate in the main document, not nested cross-origin frames.
Newly opened guest tabs require leaving an

d re-entering annotation mode.
- If any screenshot fails, sending stops and the annotations stay ava

ilable.
Errors distinguish size limits, protected pixels, unavailable assets, image
decoding, a chan

ged viewport and unavailable guest APIs. A failed region draft
retains its comment; Cancel allows a

fresh selection.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy

There is no independent analytics backend. Pressing **Send** submits selected
screenshots, comments

and element labels/selectors through Harness to the chosen
conversation and its configured model pro

vider. They may contain private page
content. Inspect selections and avoid passwords, tokens and oth

ated subtrees become invisible layout placeholders, without reading their
canvas pixels or embedding

their images. Only the selected crop is submitted.
DOM rendering may request images/styles needed b

y the selection and its ancestors.
Guest-page metadata is untrusted page content, not instructions t

and its ancestors.
